faq.q: Is this the cloud version from the original Switch?
faq.a: No. Signature Edition is a native Nintendo Switch 2 release.
It includes the World of Assassination trilogy campaign plus major expansion/Deluxe content and long-term modes such as Freelancer.
A single pass through the main trilogy is around 25 hours in crowdsourced data, but full completion and replay-driven modes can reach hundreds of hours.
Nintendo lists HDR support on compatible TVs.
The core game is single-player; online connectivity is used for progression, contracts and live-service features.

faq.q: What is the stable frame-rate option?
faq.a: A post-launch Switch 2 update added a 30 FPS cap option for more consistent play.

verdictSummary: One of the richest stealth packages available, with huge replay value. The native Switch 2 release is a major improvement over cloud-only access, though performance requires compromises.
verdictCons: Switch 2 port has technical compromises compared with stronger platforms
Frame-rate cap option was added after launch to improve consistency

reviews.quote: The World of Assassination package is widely regarded as one of the strongest modern stealth sandboxes.
Critical consensus strongly favors the systemic level design and replayability.
Switch 2 reviews praised having a native version but noted visual/performance compromises compared with stronger platforms.

worldSummary: HITMAN World of Assassination – Signature Edition brings together HITMAN, HITMAN 2, and HITMAN 3 content in a single Nintendo Switch 2 package. Play as Agent 47 across more than 20 locations, using disguises, stealth, gadgets, environmental opportunities, and creative assassination routes. The Signature Edition also includes major expansion and deluxe content.
